# Tests known to fail now and then on code that cannot reach them.
#
# When a CI test run fails and every failed test is named here,
# scripts/retry-flaky.sh runs those tests once more. The job passes if they
# pass the second time, and it prints a warning that names them. A failure of
# any test not named here fails the job without a retry.
#
# One top-level test name per line, then a comment that says where it failed.
# Remove a line in the change that fixes the test.

# e2e/tui
TestPasteBuffersKeepYanksAndPasteThem            # failed on #940 and on main after #983
TestAnImagePastedIntoAnSSHShellGoesToThatMachine # the tmux subtest, shard 2 (#978)

# go test ./...
TestFloatedPaneStaysFloatedEverywhere            # internal/app, failed on #940 (plot only)
